title: Locating isolas in nonlinear oscillator systems using uncertainty quantification
summary: Parametric uncertainty in nonlinear dynamical systems can fundamentally alter bifurcation behaviour, leading to qualitative response changes. Predicting operating margins/envelopes under such uncertainties is critical but challenging: conventional uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods struggle to efficiently propagate uncertainties across bifurcation boundaries, where response gradients become singular and solution branches emerge/vanish.
